summary: Annexon, Inc. filed a Form 8-K with Items 8.01 and 9.01 on August 6, 2026, attaching a press release regarding positive clinical data from its FORWARD study of tanruprubart in Guillain-Barré syndrome. The registrant reported rapid, positive responses in ten patients within one week. This is a routine operational update on clinical trial results, not a special-situation corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, advisory roles, or strategic actions are mentioned. The filing serves solely as disclosure of clinical progress, with implications for regulatory submissions but no special-category classification.
